import subprocess,json,pathlib,datetime,re
r=subprocess.run(['docker','inspect','minecraft'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True); c=json.loads(r.stdout)[0]
props={}
for line in pathlib.Path('/opt/docker/minecraft/data/server.properties').read_text().splitlines():
 if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
  k,v=line.split('=',1)
  if k in ['online-mode','enable-rcon','max-players','gamemode','difficulty','white-list','server-port']:props[k]=v
world=pathlib.Path('/opt/docker/minecraft/data/world')
metrics=subprocess.run(['docker','exec','teamspeak-collector','cat','/textfile/teamspeak.prom'],capture_output=True,text=True)
checks=[]
for line in metrics.stdout.splitlines():
 if re.match(r'teamspeak_(local_up|public_up|last_probe_timestamp_seconds)\{',line):
  m=re.search(r'server="([^"]*)"',line)
  checks.append({'metric':line.split('{',1)[0],'server':m.group(1) if m else None,'value':line.rsplit(' ',1)[-1]})
print(json.dumps({'observed_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'container':{'id':c['Id'],'state':c['State']['Status'],'health':c['State'].get('Health',{}).get('Status'),'started':c['State']['StartedAt'],'restart_count':c['RestartCount'],'oom_killed':c['State']['OOMKilled'],'memory_limit':c['HostConfig']['Memory'],'image':c['Config']['Image']},'world':{'inode':world.stat().st_ino,'level_dat_exists':(world/'level.dat').is_file()},'server_properties':props,'filesystem':{'bytes_free':__import__('shutil').disk_usage('/').free},'teamspeak_metrics':checks},indent=2))
print(subprocess.run(['docker','ps','--format','{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout)
